# lets

> Locate · Edit · Transform · Show — a file-operations CLI for coding agents. One Bash call
> reads, locates, edits or transforms several files and returns bounded, numbered output
> whose footer names everything left out.

## Reference
- [Guide](../docs/guide.md): the one-screen `lets guide` output — every verb, the target
  grammar, every exit code.
- [For a calling agent](../docs/agents.md): exit codes and slugs, the `--json`/`--jsonl`
  shape, the footer contract, how discovery delivers this file's own existence to an agent.
- [Examples](../docs/examples/): generated, passing command transcripts, one file per verb.
- [README](../README.md): installation and a quickstart.
- [Site llms.txt](https://lets.mayberuk.com/llms.txt): the same reference, plus the rendered
  Manual at [lets.mayberuk.com/docs/](https://lets.mayberuk.com/docs/).
